author: nemi
text: Hang on, turn around for a second. They're toys. It's a rehearsal! I've spent the entire morning rehearsing my apology to a duck. And look at its face, why does it seem like it knows? Nine takes the microphone; eight lets me hide. Please pick before I start explaining myself to the bear.
